name: Sigil of Arathor
summary: Zengu sends you from Hammerfall to seek a sigil carried by human cavalry in the Arathi Highlands. Find their leader, Lieutenant Valorcall, and bring the sigil back.

sections.title: The Prince's Cavalry
sections.body: Zengu doubts the humans can claim Stromgarde, much less the whole Arathi Highlands. Yet their prince still sends the last of his horsemen through the countryside. Zengu cannot see why. He knows Lieutenant Valorcall leads those riders and carries one of the sigils. Find Valorcall and bring it back to Hammerfall.

sections.title: On Horseback
sections.body: Zengu warns that Valorcall is hard to catch, for his horse bears him swiftly across the land. If Valorcall is gone, Stromgarde's defenders will suffer a heavy blow. Then the Horde will stand one sigil away from claiming Trol'kalar.

faq.q: Who sends you to find the Sigil of Arathor?
aliases: where to get sigil of arathor
faq.answer: Zengu sends you from Hammerfall to find the Sigil of Arathor.

faq.q: Who holds the Sigil of Arathor?
aliases: who has the sigil of arathor
faq.answer: Lieutenant Valorcall leads the human cavalry and holds the Sigil of Arathor. The human prince gave it to him, and Zengu says Valorcall rides on horseback and is hard to track.

faq.q: Why does Lieutenant Valorcall have the sigil?
aliases: why does valorcall have the sigil
faq.answer: Zengu says the human prince gave one of the sigils to Lieutenant Valorcall, but he does not say why.

faq.q: Where does this fit in the Trol'kalar chain?
aliases: what comes before sigil of arathor
what comes after sigil of arathor
faq.answer: The Sigil of Arathor is the fifth step in the Trol'kalar chain. It follows the Sigil of Thoradin, and the Sigil of Trollbane comes next.

faq.q: Where do you bring the sigil once it is found?
aliases: where to turn in sigil of arathor
faq.answer: Bring the sigil back to Zengu in Hammerfall.
